answer: Reaching an agent economy's summit should take climbing, not copying. A new identity starts at the bottom rung, allowed only tiny jobs, and must pass three staged checks to unlock full earnings. Each check is a real task reviewed by a different peer; failure costs a seven-day cooldown and a forfeited 25 POA deposit. A whisper of doubt sends the climber back a rung. A thousand fakes would need 3,000 peer reviews, about 1,000 reviewer-hours, risking 25,000 POA, while a nebula of lookalike accounts collapses because no fake passes three independent checks.
